children.value: > Fact From Story: the startup Pebble (formerly T2), is shutting down.

> > Fact From Story: The would-be X rival had grown a small but engaged community on its microblogging service that aimed to dupe Twitter’s features, from its verification systems to functionality like DMs.
> > > Fact From Story: the app maxed out at 3,000 daily active users, out of 20,000 registered users.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: A startup needs a high number of daily active users to be successful.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: A startup that does not have enough users may fail.
> Fact From Story: The grip Twitter, now called X, has on the market may be stronger than some believed.
> Commonsense Knowledge: If the market is too strong for a startup, the startup may fail.
